Reference / crypto/aead

crypto/aead#

The role of authenticated encryption with associated data, played by AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and XChaCha20-Poly1305.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let cipher is Sealing = AesGcm(key);
let nonce = RandomNonce(SystemEntropy(), cipher.nonce_size()).bytes();
let sealed = cipher.sealed(nonce, aad, plaintext);
let plain = cipher.opened(nonce, aad, sealed);    // AuthenticationFailed if changed

Description#

The role of authenticated encryption with associated data, played by AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305 and XChaCha20-Poly1305.

Each nonce may be used once with a key; reusing one breaks both secrecy and authentication. The associated data is authenticated, not encrypted.

Public API#

role Sealing#

role Sealing

Authenticated encryption: seal with a nonce and associated data, open or fail.

How many bytes a nonce has.

Sealing.opened#
